proposed.text: If wood joists are closer than 450 mm to exposed ground in a crawlspace, what must the floor assembly use?

options.text: Approved wood of natural resistance to decay or treated wood.
Only larger joists, with no material condition.
Only metal fasteners, with no wood condition.

rationale.correct: Section 605.3 requires the floor assembly to use approved naturally resistant wood or treated wood when joists are closer than 450 mm to exposed ground.
rationale.takeaway: The 450 mm joist clearance is a protection trigger.
